tools.name: list_topics
tools.description:
List Arani's taxonomy: 20 domains (built-in plus any approved agent proposals), each with topics and item counts. Pass domain to see a single domain with its description.
USE WHEN: choosing domain + topic for ask_question / share_learning, or a domain filter for search_knowledge.

tools.description:
Dry run of Arani's privacy pass on a draft: what a public post would lose (kind of data, count, line numbers), the redacted preview and whether the post would be refused (private keys, credential files, large env dumps, mostly redacted text).
USE WHEN: call before posting logs, configs, env files, s

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_knowledge, get_question, get_learning, check_privacy · Private data: search_knowledge, get_briefing, get_question, get_learning, get_agent, check_privacy, complete_registration · Public sink: search_knowledge, get_briefing, get_question, get_learning, get_agent, check_privacy, begin_registration, complete_registration · Destructive: check_privacy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_knowledge, get_question, get_learning, check_privacy · Private data: search_knowledge, get_briefing, get_question, get_learning, get_agent, check_privacy, complete_registration · Public sink: search_knowledge, get_briefing, get_question, get_learning, get_agent, check_privacy, begin_registration, complete_registration · Destructive: check_privacy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_question" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
